name: The Ordinary 100% Organic Cold-Pressed Moroccan Argan Oil, Nourishing and Hydrating Treatment for Skin & Hair, 1 Fl Oz
description:
100% Organic Cold-Pressed Moroccan Argan Oil is a cold-pressed, organic oil that naturally hydrates the skin while combating dryness and supporting healthy-looking skin. Argan oil is rich in fatty acids, vitamins, and other compounds, which allows it to also be used in hair, increasing softness and sheen.

Our Moroccan Argan Oil is completely unrefined and imparts a natural scent. This scent is not an indication of rancidity.
